acip: MA GRUB NA, DKAR PO DANG DMAR PO GNYIS KYI GZHI MTHUN MED PAR THAL, DKAR PO DANG DMAR PO GNYIS 'GAL BA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, dkar po dang dmar po gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med par thal, dkar po dang dmar po gnyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that it is impossible for one thing to be entirely white and entirely red. Suppose you do disagree.  It is too impossible for one thing to be entirely white and entirely red at the same time. Why do you say that? Because being entirely white and being entirely red are two contradictory things.
